notes:
Summary: Montclair QueryGarden is a mid-market productivity SaaS building contextual search and in-app recommendations for their collaboration product. They currently run nightly batch embedding jobs over ~50M documents and need sub-100ms top-k retrieval for interactive search. Interested in starting on Hosted API for speed of rollout but likely want Dedicated after POC for predictable throughput and cost controls.

Key technical asks / quotes:
- Throughput target: sustain 200 qps embedding writes during nightly window; 500 qps read (k-NN) during peak search bursts.
- Latency target: 90th percentile < 120ms for top-k retrieval at 8 concurrent shards.
- "We can't afford noisy spikes during our morning peak — predictable tail latency is everything." — VP Eng
- Vector DB: currently evaluating Pinecone vs self-hosted FAISS/Annoy; want a tested connector and guidance on shard sizing.
- Batch: incremental embedding runs (delta-only) and retry semantics; need API support for bulk upserts and idempotency.

Security / compliance notes:
- SOC2 + SSO (SAML) mandatory; want audit logs for token-level usage and per-route tracing.
- KMS integration for keys; retention policy questions from legal (30/90/365 day options).

Commercial / procurement:
- Price sensitivity: ARR target band $100k-$250k; prefer committed Dedicated pricing but need Hosted POC to prove unit economics.
- Procurement timeline: procurement kickoff mid-March; legal review for DPA and data residency by end of March.

POC acceptance criteria (agreed with SE on 2026-03-03):
1) Throughput: host-managed embeddings ingestion must saturate to 200 qps sustained during 2-hour nightly window without >1% error rate.
2) Retrieval latency: 90p < 120ms for 100k concurrent vectors sample.
3) Integration: Pinecone connector and S3-backed snapshot of index works with their orchestration.
4) Cost: demo run with Redwood Optimize recommendations shows >=20% unit-cost improvement vs baseline configuration.
workload_summary: Mix of real-time search queries (low latency, bursty) and large nightly embedding batches (~50M docs). Index refreshes nightly with delta-only uploads. Expect growth 2x over next 12 months.
requirements_summary: Need Hosted API POC to validate latency/cost, then Dedicated committed pool for predictable throughput. Must support bulk embedding upserts, strong retry/idempotency, and connector to Pinecone/FAISS. Audit logs and SSO mandatory.
technical_details: Current infra: Postgres primary metadata store, Celery batch workers for embedding generation, S3 for raw docs. Using open-embed models in-house for embeddings; evaluating Redwood models for consistency and cost. Interested in KV cache for short-term hot docs and autoscale policies for read bursts.
